claims.statement: Every real 5x5 correlation matrix C of rank at most 3 satisfies per(C o C) <= (13/48) per(C)^2.
claims.equality: signed simultaneous permutations of J2 direct-sum E3

claims.statement: Real 5x5 positive-semidefinite matrices A and B of rank at most 3 satisfy per(A o B) <= (13/48) per(A) per(B).
claims.equality: positive-diagonal normalizations have a common 2+3 block partition and independent diagonal sign switches; a zero diagonal in either matrix gives degenerate equality
